headline: Weathered Sector Leads Renewed Base Turnover
war_summary: Since the last edition, WeatheredExpanseHex has become the war’s busiest ledger, rising to thirty base events in twenty-four hours and eleven in six, with seven in the latest two-hour window. Its holdings remain divided, six Warden to three Colonial, while the casualty rate has cooled from the earlier rush. MooringCountyHex has likewise sharpened, recording three events in two hours and five across the day; the Wardens hold ten of twelve bases against two Colonial positions, amid more than 2,100 reported casualties in the latest two hours. StonecradleHex remains split four Warden to five Colonial, with ten daily events and three in six hours, though fighting is easing. FarranacCoastHex has nine daily events and four in six hours, but its Colonial majority stands at ten bases to one. LinnMercyHex records nine daily events and accelerating enlistments and casualties, despite all eleven bases remaining Colonial. FishermansRowHex has fourteen daily events, yet no turnover in the latest six hours, suggesting a front that has gone quiet for now.
